proposals.evidence: DEDR529 explicitly gives Malayalam/Tamil iṟacci and Kodagu eraci flesh/meat. Paniya Irechi preserves the initial vowel and Ravula Rechi lacks it; both preserve the r-plus-affricate shape and exact meat referent. The vowel-less Ravula comparison remains a proposed correspondence, not a source emendation. The alternative Pengo etymology is not used. proposals.evidence: DEDR5517 explicitly gives Kannada beṅge heat/fire, Tulu bēnkè heat and Kannada ben-nīr hot water. The source Benge Neeru is proposed as heat/hot plus water (3690 nīru), with both ordered constituents retained. The lexical first member is attested, but source-local inheritance versus transmission remains open. DEDR nodes denote the full articles; no heading or source spelling is changed.
